wstep: There is no recipe here for cantaloupe melon jam with ginger.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Melons are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.

akapity: According to an FDA table of approximate values, cantaloupe melon has a pH of 6.17–7.13.
The FDA list gives cantaloupe a pH of about 6.13–6.58.
The FDA list gives ginger a pH of about 5.60–5.90.
The University of California does not recommend canning low-acid fruits such as melon, because a boiling water bath is not hot enough to reduce the risk of botulism.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for cantaloupe jam from a checked source.
